title: Bali Adventure with Rafting and Nusa Penida
alt: Rafting on the Ayung river near Ubud, Bali
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Mount Batur and the Ayung river
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Kintamani with Ubud and coffee plantation
activities.description: A full day through central Bali with a coffee plantation tasting, the Tegalalang rice terraces, the Ubud palace and the crater lake view at Kintamani.

activities.name: Mount Batur sunrise by jeep
activities.match: Sunrise At Mount Batur by Jeep
activities.description: A four wheel drive up the volcano in the dark for sunrise on the black lava field, followed by a soak in the Batur hot springs.

activities.name: Campuhan ridge walk and Tegenungan
activities.description: The green ridge path between two rivers on the edge of Ubud town, then the wide curtain of Tegenungan waterfall in the afternoon.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights inland with a coffee plantation day, a jeep sunrise on Mount Batur, the Campuhan ridge path and a waterfall in the afternoon.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Nusa Penida and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet hotel with a pool, walking distance from Kuta beach

activities.name: Ayung river white water rafting
activities.description: Twelve kilometres of grade two and three rapids on the Ayung river, past jungle walls and carved rock faces, with all gear and a guide in the raft.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast by speedboat
activities.description: Speedboat across for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay, the three viewpoints that make Nusa Penida worth the early start.

activities.name: Snorkelling at Crystal Bay
activities.description: Mask and fins in the clear water of Crystal Bay on the way back, with coral heads and reef fish close to the shore.

activities.name: Uluwatu and Padang Padang beach
activities.description: The cove at Padang Padang beach and the cliff top temple at Uluwatu, timed so you are there as the sun goes into the ocean.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast with rafting on the Ayung river, a full day on Nusa Penida with snorkelling, and the cliffs of Uluwatu at sunset.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud resort and settle in
Rest of the day free in Bali's green interior
Optional: the Monkey Forest, Celuk silver village or the art market
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
The crater lake view, then the Tegalalang rice terraces
Ubud palace and the market lanes on the way back
3: Very early jeep ride up the lava slopes of Mount Batur
Sunrise over the caldera, then the Batur hot springs
The Campuhan ridge walk between two rivers
4: Breakfast and check out, then on to the Ayung river
Twelve kilometres of rafting through jungle gorges
Private transfer down to Kuta and check in
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong and Broken Bay
Snorkelling at Crystal Bay before the boat back
6: Breakfast, then a half day to the southern cliffs
Padang Padang beach in its limestone cove
Uluwatu temple above the surf at sunset
Optional: the Kecak fire dance at the temple
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your return flight

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: This is the active Bali. Volcano at dawn, river rapids by day, island beaches after. Families with teenagers love it.
expert.tip: Rafting and the Batur jeep both need a change of clothes and shoes you do not mind soaking. Keep the camera in a dry bag and let us hold your main luggage at the hotel on moving day.

summary: Seven days of active Bali with return flights: a jeep sunrise on Mount Batur, the Campuhan ridge walk, rafting on the Ayung river, Nusa Penida with snorkelling at Crystal Bay and the cliffs of Uluwatu at sunset.
included: Included: return international flights; 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and coffee plantation tour; Mount Batur jeep sunrise with hot springs; Campuhan ridge walk and Tegenungan; Ayung river rafting; Nusa Penida tour with snorkelling; Uluwatu and Padang Padang.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
